scenario: A water utility compares two leak-repair crews across dense urban grids, suburban networks, and mountainous pipe corridors. The utility prefers Crew A because its aggregate same-day repair rate is much higher.

data.description: Same-day repair by terrain class and crew.

question: (a) Which crew performs better in each terrain class? (b) If the long-run network mix is 30% dense urban, 40% suburban, and 30% mountain corridors, compute the corrected same-day repair rate for each crew. (c) Which crew should be preferred?

ground_truth.explanation: Crew B is modestly better in all strata; Crew A only benefits from a much easier job mix.

naive_answer: Crew A is better because its overall same-day rate is much higher.
naive_trap: The aggregate comparison is driven by terrain mix rather than crew quality.
